highlights.title: Z.ai to Rival Anthropic, OpenAI in Coding With New AI Model
highlights.description: Z.ai Co. is set to upgrade its flagship AI model, adding to a series of Chinese open-weight offerings seeking to outcompete Anthropic PBC and OpenAI.

highlights.title: OpenAI ditches Recall-style screenshot surveillance for friendly keylogging
highlights.description: 'Computer History' records clicks and typing to build ChatGPT memories

highlights.title: Uber partners with China's Pony.ai for 2,000 robotaxis in Europe
highlights.description: The rollout comes as robotaxi fleet sizes become increasingly critical for commercialization.

highlights.title: Kushner’s Thrive Fund Grows Sevenfold to $3.7 Billion on AI Bets
highlights.description: Thrive Capital’s 2022 early-stage venture capital fund, a $516 million investment vehicle that made early bets on OpenAI, SpaceX and Anduril Industries Inc., has grown to be worth more than $3.7 billion as of the end of June.

highlights.title: China built robots that can do backflips – but can they make money?
highlights.description: Unitree’s IPO will gauge investors’ appetite for a technology that has yet to prove its commercial viability amid intensifying geopolitical tensions.

highlights.title: From Apple to Ford: How Chinese tech is becoming harder for global companies to ignore
highlights.description: Global companies are increasingly tapping Chinese technology for its growing capabilities and scale, even as geopolitical risks remain.

highlights.title: Alibaba, Baidu, Kuaishou Address Mounting AI Costs as Competition Intensifies
highlights.description: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd., Baidu Inc. and Kuaishou Technology are the next big names in tech that will have to address concerns over the mounting financial costs needed to sustain intense AI competition.

highlights.title: Bitcoin holders Strategy and Metaplanet face stock-index exclusion under MSCI’s new proposal
highlights.description: A new consultation targets "non-operating companies" broadly. Two familiar names still land on the deletion list.

highlights.title: Apple sends out warnings to targets of mercenary spyware attacks
highlights.description: Apple has recently sent out notifications, warning users that they'd been targeted by mercenary spyware attack.

highlights.title: India Less Exposed to AI Job Risks Than Others, Goldman Says
highlights.description: India’s labor force is unlikely to face widespread job losses from artificial intelligence, though some positions in the services sector could be affected, Goldman Sachs Group’s Chief India economist Santanu Sengupta said Friday.
